name: Payment Processing
description: Processes customer payments (domestic transfers, card settlements) via REST API.
technology_stack: Java 21 / Spring Boot REST API, PostgreSQL, Kafka

name: Core Banking
description: System of record for customer accounts, balances and ledger postings.
technology_stack: Core banking package, Oracle Database, IBM MQ

name: Customer Services
description: API layer that provides customer, account and transaction status information to channels.
technology_stack: Python FastAPI microservice, Redis cache, OAuth2 / SSO

name: Transaction Reconciliation
description: Reconciles payment transactions against core banking ledger postings.
technology_stack: Python batch jobs, SQL, Control-M scheduler

name: Reporting & Data Warehouse
description: Generates financial, regulatory and operational reports.
technology_stack: SQL data warehouse, ETL pipelines, BI dashboards
